pages.title: Hexbrew Solvent
pages.text: The base of all brewing. It has no drinking or throwing effect of its own, and each bottle holds 250 mB. Every other hexbrew starts from it, and hexbrews brewed through the solvent stack up to 16 bottles when they carry the same effects.

pages.title: Explosive Hexbrew
pages.text: Thrown, it explodes: it breaks no blocks and spares your allies. A magic bomb built for hitting enemies.

pages.title: Miasma Hexbrew
pages.text: Thrown, it inflicts Miasma for 60 seconds. Each level of Miasma makes its target take 50% more damage, halves armor effectiveness by 50%, and reduces healing by 30%; a hurt target may also pick up negative effects.

pages.title: Hexbrew Elixir
pages.text: It is the ingredient behind the most unusual hexbrews.

pages.title: Shield Hexbrew
pages.text: Drunk, it grants Starlight Shield for 3 minutes with extra absorption.

pages.title: Starlight Hexbrew
pages.text: Thrown, it bursts into starlight and inflicts Sparkling for 3 minutes; every time a Sparkling target is hit, it erupts in a ring of star bullets that fight for you.

pages.title: Hyphae Hexbrew
pages.text: Thrown, it inflicts Hyphae Infection for 3 minutes, dealing 1 magic damage each second. It also briefly grows hyphae and turns the dirt within 4 blocks into mycelium.
